calendarNotConfigured: Google Calendar has not been configured on this server.
calendarNotConnected: Connect Google Calendar before selecting or syncing calendars.
calendarInvalidState: This Google Calendar connection attempt has expired or is invalid. Start again.
calendarInvalidToken: Google Calendar authorization expired or was rejected. Reconnect your account.
calendarProviderUnavailable: Google Calendar is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
calendarInvalidSnapshot: Google Calendar returned an incomplete or invalid result. Your saved events were preserved.
calendarConflict: The selection limit was reached or the connection changed. Refresh and try again.
googleCalendarSelectionNotFound: That calendar or selection is not available to your account.
calendarPublishNotFound: This calendar publication is not available to your account.
calendarPublishStale: The preview expired, the events changed, or the confirmation did not match. Preview again before enabling publishing.
calendarPublishTooMany: Choose a narrower event filter or shorter horizon. Publishing supports at most 100 upcoming occurrences and 10 active destinations per account.
calendarPublishNotReady: Connect and sync this calendar before publishing. Resuming or reconnecting requires a new publishing preview.
calendarPublishConflict: Publishing is already active for this calendar and channel. Stop it before changing its settings.
calendarPublishForbidden: You need Manage Server and access to send messages in this channel. The bot needs View Channel, Send Messages and Embed Links. Creating Discord Events also requires event permissions.
calendarPublishDestination: Choose a text or announcement channel in the selected server that both you and the bot can access.
calendarPublishUnavailable: Calendar publishing is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
calendarPublicEventDescription: Imported calendar date. Personal reminders and completion history remain private.
